thread:
maria-cs: Hey team — StellarDocs onboarding is blocked. They report 429s during SDK init on mobile web. QA run tomorrow, customer anxious. Can we triage?

olivia-support: Seeing multiple small clusters of 429s in our support dashboard tied to their org key. Error payloads are `init_preflight` and `token_refresh`.

maria-cs: Pasted the minimal repro logs they sent: 
```
{ "time":"2026-03-22T15:21:12Z", "event":"sdk.init", "org":"org-XXX", "status":429, "msg":"rate limit - preflight" }
{ "time":"2026-03-22T15:21:12Z", "event":"serviceworker.fetch", "url":"/api/init", "status":200 }
{ "time":"2026-03-22T15:21:13Z", "event":"sdk.init", "status":429 }
```
They said this happens when a background sync + page load both try to init at the same time.

devon-eng: Thanks. That pattern (SW + main thread both doing init) will fan out preflights. My guess: duplicate token fetches and parallel preflight requests hitting our per-org short-window burst limits.

kai-sre: Confirmed on rate dashboards: org-XXX had ~1200 preflight requests/min in a 60s window around 15:21 — enough to trip our ephemeral burst guard. I can apply a temporary mitigation at the edge.

maria-cs: What mitigations can we offer quickly? Customer can't change SW behavior before tomorrow.

devon-eng: Two quick options: 
1) Client-side patch (recommended long term): dedupe init calls in the SDK using a singleflight promise + check for service worker context. e.g. `if (navigator.serviceWorker && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) { /* coordinate with main thread or defer */ }` and share a singleton `initPromise`.
2) Server-side temporary: throttle-coalesce their org key for next 4 hours so duplicate preflights are collapsed into one upstream token fetch.

devon-eng: Minimal SDK snippet: `let _init; function init() { if (_init) return _init; _init = fetchTokenWithBackoff().finally(() => _init = null); return _init; }` Add jittered backoff on 429s and cap concurrent preflights to 3.

kai-sre: I can open a support ACL to coalesce preflights for org-XXX and raise their short-window burst cap by +500 for 4h. Need explicit approval from CS (maria) to make the change.

olivia-support: I have org-XXX contact in DM and they approved a temp server-side tweak. Scheduling a 30m session at 09:30 PT to walk through logs and apply SDK patch after.

maria-cs: Approved. Please apply the edge coalescing and burst bump. Also can we extend ephemeral token TTL from 20s -> 45s for their org while we patch? That would reduce refresh storms.

kai-sre: Applied: edge coalescing ON for org-XXX, burst cap +500 for 4h, ephemeral TTL +25s. Monitoring now. redwood-ratebot will post alerts if errors persist.

redwood-ratebot: alert: org-XXX preflight spike detected (1200 rpm) -> edge coalescing enabled, burst +500 applied (expires in 4h).

maria-cs: Thanks all. I'll update StellarDocs and join the 09:30 PT call. Post-call action items: 1) dev patch to SDK for singleflight + jittered backoff, 2) docs note about SW integration pattern, 3) evaluate default TTL options.

devon-eng: I'll open a PR with the singleflight snippet and a short doc page on SW integration patterns. Tagging `#eng-runtime` for any questions on gateway header support for `x-client-coalesce`.

olivia-support: Adding meeting invite and recording link once done. Good triage team :thumbsup:
